text: Waffle Cones P5 minutes C1 minutes S1 Ingredients: Strawberry Waffle Tray 1 Australian Waffle Co Belgian Style Liege Waffle 1 banana, sliced 1 scoop ice cream Caramel sauce Cream-filled chocolate biscuit crumbs Nutella Nut Waffle Cone 1 Australian Waffle Co Homestyle Toasting Waffle 1 scoop ice cream Choc-hazelnut spread, warmed Chopped hazelnuts Strawberries, to serve Method: Toast the Australian Waffle Co Belgian Style Liege Waffle, place in takeaway tray and top with either: a) Banana, ice cream and caramel sauce. Sprinkle with biscuit crumbs and serve immediately. b) Hazelnuts and finish with a strawberries. Serve immediately. Products used The Australian Waffle Co Belgian Style Leige Waffles The Australian Waffle Co Homestyle Toasting Waffles Tips and hints:These are a great sweet, on-the-go option for food trucks or festival food exhibitors

title: Waffle Pops
description: Toast the Australian Waffle Co Belgian Style Liege Mini Waffles, carefully insert pop sticks and working one at a time, dip in melted chocolate. Place on a tray lined with baking paper and sprinkle with choice of topping. Allow to set, then serve.
text: Waffle Pops P10 minutes C5 minutes S10 Ingredients: 10 Australian Waffle Co Belgian Style Liege Mini Waffles 10 pop sticks 400g dark, milk or white chocolate, melted Assorted sprinkles or lollies and toasted nuts (toasted flaked or slivered almonds, slivered pistachios, walnuts, chopped roasted hazelnuts or macadamias) Method: Toast the Australian Waffle Co Belgian Style Liege Mini Waffles, carefully insert pop sticks and working one at a time, dip in melted chocolate. Place on a tray lined with baking paper and sprinkle with choice of topping. Allow to set, then serve. Alternatively, toast, dip and sprinkle to order and serve warm. Products used The Australian Waffle Co Belgian Style Leige Mini Waffles

title: Warm Olive Pasta Salad
description: 600g Riviana Sliced Kalamata Olives 300g Anchovy Stuffed Olives 70g Riviana Capers 600g En Place Pesto Alla Genovese 1kg Roma tomatoes, roughly chopped 1kg dried spiral pasta 100g Parmesan cheese, shaved salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
text: Warm Olive Pasta Salad P15 minutes C30 minutes S12 Ingredients: 600g Riviana Sliced Kalamata Olives 300g Anchovy Stuffed Olives 70g Riviana Capers 600g En Place Pesto Alla Genovese 1kg Roma tomatoes, roughly chopped 1kg dried spiral pasta 100g Parmesan cheese, shaved salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste Method: Place olives, capers, pesto and tomatoes in a large bowl and mix to combine. Cook pasta in plenty of boiling water until al dente. Drain. Return pasta to pot and combine with olive ingredients. Season to taste. To serve, divide pasta among serving plates and top with shaved Parmesan. Products used Sliced Kalamata Olives Capers Tips and hints:This salad is ideal for a buffet menu served at room temperature in a large bowl. For a delicious pizza topping, combine all pasta salad ingredients except pasta and top pizza bases. Sprinkle with shredded mozzarella and bake until golden.

title: Warm Tuna and Olive Scones
description: 5g Riviana Minced Garlic 415g self raising flour 100g vintage cheddar, grated 500ml sour cream 100ml milk 415g Riviana Tuna Chunks in Brine 700g Riviana Sliced Black Olives basil leaves, to taste Riviana Canola Oil Spray
text: Warm Tuna and Olive Scones P20 minutes C35 minutes S12 Ingredients: 5g Riviana Minced Garlic 415g self raising flour 100g vintage cheddar, grated 500ml sour cream 100ml milk 415g Riviana Tuna Chunks in Brine 700g Riviana Sliced Black Olives basil leaves, to taste Riviana Canola Oil Spray Method: Preheat oven to 230°C. Combine garlic, flour, cheese, sour cream and milk in a large food processor/mixer, process until mixture forms a ball. Remove dough and place on a floured board. Add tuna, olives and basil, mixing by hand until combined. Roll/pat until 3cm thick. Cut into desired shapes. Place scones on lightly floured baking trays and spray tops with canola oil. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden. Serve topped with extra basil leaves. Products used Canola Oil Spray Garlic Minced Sliced Black Olives Tips and hints:Add some Riviana Sun Dried Tomato Strips to the dough for extra flavour and colour

title: REDcycle
description: The REDcycle soft plastics recycling option for Australia stopped in November 2022.
text: REDcycle The REDcycle soft plastics recycling option for Australia stopped in November 2022. This means that soft plastic packaging that currently features the “Return to Store” REDcycle Australasian Recycling Label (ARL) logo cannot be returned to store. A Soft Plastics Taskforce has now been formed to explore solutions to reintroduce a return to store model in Australia. What can I do with my soft plastic packaging in the interim? Check if soft plastics recycling is available in your local area here: Australasian Recycling Label (arl.org.au) If kerbside recycling is not currently available, you will need to dispose of your soft plastic packaging in the landfill bin. Please periodically check back in at arl.org.au as pilot kerbside recycling programs are rolled out across Australia. What is Riviana Food Service doing about soft plastics? Riviana Food Service has made a commitment to meet the Australian Packaging Covenant Organisation (APCO) targets by the end of 2025 including 0% single use plastic, 100% reusable, recyclable or compostable packaging and 50% recycled packaging. We also remain committed to supporting the wider industry to find alternative solutions for soft plastic packaging. That’s why we are a Foundation Supporter of the National Plastics Recycling Scheme (National Plastics Recycling Scheme – Australian Food and Grocery Council (afgc.org.au), which is focused on finding a solution to kerbside soft plastic recycling in Australia. We’re also working with our packaging suppliers to find alternative sustainable solutions. Loading...

title: Antipasto Platter with Artichoke Dip
description: The quick to prepare artichoke dip adds an extra flavour dimension to this appetising antipasto platter.
text: Antipasto Platter with Artichoke Dip P15 Minutes The quick to prepare artichoke dip adds an extra flavour dimension to this appetising antipasto platter. Ingredients: 150g Riviana Artichoke Hearts, drained100g Riviana Grilled Sliced Eggplant3/4 cup mayonnaise½ cup fresh herbs, chopped (parsley, coriander and basil)¼ tsp sea salt¼ tsp cracked pepperRiviana Sweet Spiced Gherkins Riviana Stuffed OlivesRiviana Marinated Fire Roasted Red Pepper Strips Always Fresh CrustiniAlways Fresh Grissini Method: 1. Using a blender combine the artichoke hearts, eggplant, mayonnaise, herbs, salt and pepper until almost smooth. 2. Arrange all ingredients on a board/platter and serve with the Artichoke Dip.

title: Brown Rice Salad
description: A filling and flavoursome meal in itself and also suitable as a menu side-dish.
text: Brown Rice Salad C60 Minutes S6 A filling and flavoursome meal in itself and also suitable as a menu side-dish. Ingredients: 1 cup Riviana Brown Long Grain Rice2 cups water3/4 cup Riviana Red Wine Vinegar1⁄2 cup sultanas2-3 tbsp Always Fresh Olive Oil1⁄2 cup pine nuts2 red onions, sliced1 red chilli, deseeded and finely diced½ cup Always Fresh Sliced Water Chestnuts½ cup Riviana Sliced Dill Cucumbers1 cup mint leaves1/2 cup parsley leaves, chopped2 limes, juicedSeasoning Method: 1. Place the rice in a sieve and rise well under cold water for approximately 30 seconds. Place the rice in a pot with the measured water and bring to the boil. Then place a well fitted lid on the pot, reduce the heat down to low and allow to cook for 50 - 55 minutes. 2. In a small pot add the red wine vinegar and sultanas and bring to the boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes. 3. In a hot pan with 1 tbsp of olive oil, add the pine nuts and toss until lightly browned. Remove from the pan and add some more oil (2 tbsp). Sauté the onions and chilli until translucent, approximately 2 - 3 minutes. 4. In a large bowl place the cooled rice and all of the cooked and remaining ingredients, mix lightly and serve.

title: Antipasto Platter with Jalapeno Pepper Dip and Prosciutto wrapped Grissini
description: The spicy jalapeno pepper dip is the perfect complement to an antipasto platter and this selection is sure to appeal to customers' tastebuds.
text: Antipasto Platter with Jalapeno Pepper Dip and Prosciutto wrapped Grissini P20 Minutes C20 Minutes The spicy jalapeno pepper dip is the perfect complement to an antipasto platter and this selection is sure to appeal to customers' tastebuds. Ingredients: Thinly sliced prosciutto1 tbsp fresh herbs, chopped finely1 tbsp parmesan, finely gratedAlways Fresh Grissini Sticks½ tsp Always Fresh Olive Oil1 small red onion, finely diced80g Riviana Sliced Jalapenos, diced2 large tomatoes, diced170g Gruyère, diced6 basil leavesSeasoning to tasteRiviana Pitted Black OlivesRiviana Sundried TomatoesRiviana White Cocktail Onions Method: 1. Using a clean pastry brush and some water, brush along the strips of the prosciutto then sprinkle the herbs and parmesan thinly on each slice. Remove grissini sticks from the packet, then wrap the herb and cheese crusted prosciutto around each grissini. Depending on the thickness of the prosciutto you may wish to slice it in half. 2. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan or pot. When hot, add the onion and sauté until translucent. Add the jalapeno peppers and the tomatoes and cook on a medium to high heat for 15 minutes. Take the pot off the heat and add the cheese and basil and stir through. Season and serve immediately. 3. Arrange remaining ingredients on a board/platter and serve with Prosciutto wrapped Grissini and Jalapeno Pepper Dip.

title: Vegetarian Lasagne
description: This delicious vegetarian lasagne is a winner on any menu!
text: Vegetarian Lasagne P60 Minutes C60 Minutes S8 This delicious vegetarian lasagne is a winner on any menu! Ingredients: 8 -10 sheets 4 Seasons instant lasagne sheets400ml Riviana Italian Pizza Pasta Sauce½ cup Riviana Pitted Black Olives, drained & chopped200g Garden Supreme Frozen Chopped Spinach, defrosted300g pumpkin, seeds and skin removed250g ricotta cheese150g tasty cheese (for topping)1 tsp salt1 tsp cracked pepper (plus extra pepper for the topping)2 tbsp Always Fresh Olive OilRiviana Canola Oil Spray Method: 1. Pre heat the oven to 180°C 2. To make the béchamel sauce, melt the butter in a medium sized pot and add the flour. Allow to cook for 2 minutes (to form a roux) stirring constantly. Add a little milk and continue to stir until the roux thickens, continue this until all the milk has gone. During the second addition of the milk add the bay leaf, nutmeg and seasoning. Once thickened (allow around 25 minutes), take it of the heat remove the bay leaf. Cover with waxed baking paper pushing it down onto the sauce and set aside. 3. Dice the pumpkin into 2cm x 2cm cubes and place into a bowl. Sprinkle seasoning and olive oil over the pumpkin to coat well. Place on a flat baking tray and cook until soft, takes around 20 -25 mins. 4. Grate the cheese and break up the ricotta and spinach into separate bowls. 5. To assemble, in a large rectangular dish (25 - 30cm), pour about 1 tbsp of pasta sauce on the bottom of the dish and spread evenly. Lay 3 to 4 sheets of pasta onto the sauce. Spread the béchamel sauce evenly to about 1cm in height (you need to have enough béchamel for 3 layers). Then evenly spread half of the olives, spinach, pumpkin, ricotta and around 3 tbsp of pasta sauce. Repeat this again with the pasta sheet first then all of the filling ingredients. Place a last layer of pasta sheets on the top with a good coating of béchamel and finish with the grated cheese & cracked pepper. 6. Bake for 1 hour. At around 40 minutes cover the top with tin foil (sprayed with canola spray to stop from sticking) to stop the top of the lasagne from burning.

title: Apple and Berry Crumble
description: Combining the tender taste of apple with the juiciness of berries, this dessert is a surefire winner for the winter menu.
text: Apple and Berry Crumble P45 Minutes C40 Minutes S6 Combining the tender taste of apple with the juiciness of berries, this dessert is a surefire winner for the winter menu. Ingredients: ¾ cup brown sugar¾ cup plain flour1 tsp cinnamon150g unsalted butter, at room temperature300g Riviana Diced Apples200g Garden Supreme IQF Mixed Berries, thawed¼ cup sugaricing sugarraspberry saucefreshly whipped cream Method: 1. Preheat the oven to 200°C. Grease 6 individual ceramic moulds – 10cm in height with an opening of 10cm and place on a flat baking tray for transporting the crumble safely to and from the oven. 2. In a large bowl add the brown sugar, flour and cinnamon and mix together. Add the butter and with clean fingers break up the butter and combine with the dry ingredients until you have a crumble texture. 3. In another bowl mix the apple, berries and sugar together, then divide evenly into the greased moulds. Lastly add the dry mixture on top and bake for 40 minutes or until the fruit bubbles at the edges and the crumble has a slightly crusty texture and is lightly golden. 4. Dust with icing sugar and serve with raspberry sauce and whipped cream.

title: Summer Salad with Mandarin and Pear
description: The taste of summer in a simple, easy to prepare salad.
text: Summer Salad with Mandarin and Pear P20 Minutes C15-20 Minutes S6 The taste of summer in a simple, easy to prepare salad. Ingredients: 3 skinless chicken breasts½ cup mandarin and pear juice2 tbsp lemon juice¼ cup Riviana Red Wine Vinegar¼ cup Always Fresh Olive Oil¼ tsp sea salt¼ tsp ground pepper1 tsp castor sugar150g Riviana Mandarin Segments in Light Syrup200g Riviana Halved Pears in Natural Juice½ cup cashew nuts, chopped½ cup macadamia nuts, chopped150g mixed salad leaves, washed Method: 1. Using a steamer pot, cook the chicken breast whole (takes around 15 – 20 minutes). Allow to cool before slicing across the breast, cut about 3mm in thickness. 2. To make the dressing, in a bowl add the mandarin and pear juice, lemon juice, vinegar, oil, seasoning and sugar. Use a whisk and stir until the sugar is dissolved. 3. To assemble the salad, combine all of the remaining ingredients and toss. Lastly add the dressing.

title: Apple, Peach and Strawberry Granita
description: A light and refreshing dessert perfect to serve on a warm summer's day.
text: Apple, Peach and Strawberry Granita P20 Minutes S4 A light and refreshing dessert perfect to serve on a warm summer's day. Ingredients: 1/2 cup sugar3/4 cup water1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise1 ¼ cup Riviana Yellow Peach Puree1 ¼ cup Riviana Apple & Strawberry Puree Method: 1. In a pot add the sugar, water and the vanilla bean. Bring to the boil, stirring until the sugar dissolves, then allow to simmer for a further 3 minutes. Set aside to cool. 2. Place the purees into a bowl and then add the cooled syrup, by pouring through a sieve, and mix well. 3. Pour into a rectangular flat dish and freeze until crystals form. Take out of the freezer and run fork along the crystals to break up the granita. Place back into the freezer for a few more hours then break with a fork once again. 4. Serve in cocktail glasses with fresh fruit or your favourite liquor.

title: Gourmet Burger
description: Turn the humble hamburger into something gourmet with the addition of a few special Riviana ingredients.
text: Gourmet Burger P40 Minutes C6 Minutes S6 Turn the humble hamburger into something gourmet with the addition of a few special Riviana ingredients. Ingredients: ¼ cup Always Fresh Olive Oil1 onion, finely diced1 tbsp Riviana Minced Garlic500g lean beef mince1 tbsp Riviana Tomato Puree1 cup coriander, chopped½ tsp cumin½ tsp all spicecracked pepper1 egg, whisked½ cup of breadcrumbs6 bread rolls2 tbsp butter, room temperature3 tbsp Riviana Fruit Chutney250g Riviana Grilled Sliced Eggplant250g Riviana Whole Peeled Red Peppers250g Riviana Sweet Spiced Gherkins, sliced lengthways100g mixed lettuce leaves Method: 1. In a hot pan with a teaspoon of olive oil add the onion and minced garlic and sauté until translucent, 2-3 minutes. 2. In a large bowl add the beef, tomato puree, coriander, dry spices, egg, breadcrumbs and the cooked garlic and onion. Mix this well until combined. 3. Shape into patties, approximately the same size as your bread rolls. 4. Heat a little olive oil in a pan and cook your patties until they are brown on each side, around 2-3 mins on either side. 5. Cut the bread rolls in half and using a butter knife spread the butter on the top and bottom of the roll. Next, add the fruit chutney, Eggplant, Peppers and Gherkins and then the beef patty and lettuce leaves.
